<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  document.body.classList.add("home-page");
});

(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("waveCanvas");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", { alpha: true, desynchronized: true });

  // -------------------
  // CONTENT / BRAND
  // -------------------
  const TEXT = "Decoding Data. Defining Tomorrow.";
  const FONT_FAMILY = "Quicksand, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif";

  // -------------------
  // PERFORMANCE / RESOLUTION
  // -------------------
  const DPR_CAP = 2;
  const FPS_LIMIT = 60;
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  // -------------------
  // DOT FIELD
  // -------------------
  const BG_SPACING = 11;
  const BG_JITTER = 0.9;
  const TEXT_SAMPLE_STEP = 2;
  const TEXT_JITTER = 0.45;

  // Responsive sampling (set in resize)
  let isMobile = false;
  let bgSpacing = BG_SPACING;
  let textStep = TEXT_SAMPLE_STEP;

  const DOT_R = 0.65;
  const BG_ALPHA = 0.22;
  const TEXT_ALPHA = 0.85;
  const LIT_ALPHA = 0.95;

  // -------------------
  // PARTICLE PHYSICS
  // -------------------
  const RETURN_BG = 0.040;
  const RETURN_TEXT = 0.014;
  const DAMPING = 0.86;
  const MAX_SPEED = 2.8;

  // -------------------
  // MOUSE SOLID DISK
  // -------------------
  const MOUSE_RADIUS = 2;
  const MOUSE_PUSH = 1.05;
  const MOUSE_SOFT = 0.92;
  const WAVE_MOUSE_IMPULSE = .1;

  // -------------------
  // HEAT
  // -------------------
  const HEAT_DECAY = 0.5;

  // -------------------
  // MASK RENDERING
  // -------------------
  const MASK_BLUR = 0;
  const MASK_THRESHOLD = 0.55;

  // -------------------
  // WAVE GRID (u + v velocity formulation)
  // -------------------
  const WAVE_GRID_SCALE = 3;
  const WAVE_PAD = 140;
  const WAVE_C = 0.6;

  const WAVE_DAMP_INNER = 0.00009;
  const WAVE_SIGMA_MAX  = 0.55;
  const WAVE_SIGMA_POW  = 4;

  const WAVE_VISC = 0.02;

  const PULSE_HZ = 0.10;
  const PULSE_INTERVAL = 1 / PULSE_HZ;

  const WAVE_MOUSE_INJECT = 1.8;
  const WAVE_PULSE_INJECT = 7;
  const BURST_FRAMES = 36;

  const WAVE_FORCE = 2200;
  const WAVE_HEAT  = 0.16;

  const WAVE_FORCE_TEXT = 0.14;
  const WAVE_FORCE_BG   = 0.46;
  const WAVE_FORCE_FIRST = 0.00;
  const WAVE_GRAD_CLAMP = 0.055;

  // -------------------
  // STATE
  // -------------------
  let w = 0, h = 0, dpr = 1;
  let lastT = performance.now();
  let acc = 0;

  let bg = [];
  let textPts = [];
  let all = [];

  let mouse = { x: -1e9, y: -1e9, px: -1e9, py: -1e9, active: false };

  const maskCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  const mctx = maskCanvas.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });
  let maskData = null;
  let firstMaskData = null;

  let layout = {
    fontSize: 48,
    xStart: 0,
    yMid: 0,
    firstCenter: { x: 0, y: 0 }
  };

  let firstEdgePts = [];

  let gw = 0, gh = 0;
  let gScale = 1;
  let u = null;
  let v = null;
  let u2 = null;
  let sigma = null;
  let nextPulseT = 0;
  let pulseBurst = 0;

  let running = true;
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    running = !document.hidden;
    if (running) {
      lastT = performance.now();
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  });

  const container = canvas.parentElement;
  
  // Use document for mouse tracking since canvas is fixed
  document.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = e.clientX - r.left;
    mouse.y = e.clientY - r.top;
    mouse.active = true;
  }, { passive: true });

  document.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
    mouse.active = false;
    mouse.x = -1e9; mouse.y = -1e9;
  }, { passive: true });

  const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => resize());
  ro.observe(container);

  function innerDims() {
    return {
      innerW: gw - 2 * WAVE_PAD,
      innerH: gh - 2 * WAVE_PAD
    };
  }

  function waveIndex(x, y) {
    const { innerW, innerH } = innerDims();
    const gx = (WAVE_PAD + clamp((x / w) * innerW, 1, innerW - 2)) | 0;
    const gy = (WAVE_PAD + clamp((y / h) * innerH, 1, innerH - 2)) | 0;
    return gy * gw + gx;
  }

  function injectWave(x, y, amp) {
    const i = waveIndex(x, y);
    const ix = i % gw, iy = (i / gw) | 0;
    for (let oy = -1; oy <= 1; oy++) {
      for (let ox = -1; ox <= 1; ox++) {
        const wgt = (ox === 0 && oy === 0) ? 1.0 : 0.55;
        u[(iy + oy) * gw + (ix + ox)] += amp * wgt;
      }
    }
  }

  function sampleWaveAndGrad(x, y) {
    const i = waveIndex(x, y);
    const uu = u[i];
    const dux = (u[i + 1] - u[i - 1]) * 0.5;
    const duy = (u[i + gw] - u[i - gw]) * 0.5;
    const inv = 1 / Math.max(1e-6, gScale);
    return { u: uu, gx: dux * inv, gy: duy * inv };
  }

  function waveResize() {
    gScale = WAVE_GRID_SCALE * Math.min(2, dpr);

    const innerW = Math.max(32, (w / gScale) | 0);
    const innerH = Math.max(32, (h / gScale) | 0);
    gw = innerW + 2 * WAVE_PAD;
    gh = innerH + 2 * WAVE_PAD;

    u = new Float32Array(gw * gh);
    v = new Float32Array(gw * gh);
    u2 = new Float32Array(gw * gh);
    sigma = new Float32Array(gw * gh);

    const innerX0 = WAVE_PAD;
    const innerY0 = WAVE_PAD;
    const innerX1 = gw - WAVE_PAD - 1;
    const innerY1 = gh - WAVE_PAD - 1;

    for (let y = 0; y < gh; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < gw; x++) {
        const i = y * gw + x;

        const inInner = (x >= innerX0 && x <= innerX1 && y >= innerY0 && y <= innerY1);
        if (inInner) {
          sigma[i] = WAVE_DAMP_INNER;
          continue;
        }

        const dx = (x < innerX0) ? (innerX0 - x) : (x > innerX1 ? (x - innerX1) : 0);
        const dy = (y < innerY0) ? (innerY0 - y) : (y > innerY1 ? (y - innerY1) : 0);
        const d = Math.max(dx, dy);
        const t = clamp(d / WAVE_PAD, 0, 1);
        const s = Math.pow(t, WAVE_SIGMA_POW);
        sigma[i] = WAVE_DAMP_INNER + WAVE_SIGMA_MAX * s;
      }
    }
  }

  function injectVelDisk(x, y, impulse, radPx) {
    const { innerW, innerH } = innerDims();
    const gx0 = (WAVE_PAD + clamp((x / w) * innerW, 1, innerW - 2)) | 0;
    const gy0 = (WAVE_PAD + clamp((y / h) * innerH, 1, innerH - 2)) | 0;

    const r = Math.max(1, (radPx / gScale) | 0);
    const r2 = r * r;

    for (let oy = -r; oy <= r; oy++) {
      const gy = gy0 + oy;
      if (gy <= 0 || gy >= gh - 1) continue;
      for (let ox = -r; ox <= r; ox++) {
        const gx = gx0 + ox;
        if (gx <= 0 || gx >= gw - 1) continue;

        const d2 = ox * ox + oy * oy;
        if (d2 > r2) continue;

        const t = 1 - d2 / (r2 + 1e-6);
        const wgt = t * t;
        v[gy * gw + gx] += impulse * wgt;
      }
    }
  }

  function injectWaveDisk(x, y, amp, radPx) {
    const { innerW, innerH } = innerDims();
    const gx0 = (WAVE_PAD + clamp((x / w) * innerW, 1, innerW - 2)) | 0;
    const gy0 = (WAVE_PAD + clamp((y / h) * innerH, 1, innerH - 2)) | 0;

    const r = Math.max(1, (radPx / gScale) | 0);
    const r2 = r * r;

    for (let oy = -r; oy <= r; oy++) {
      const gy = gy0 + oy;
      if (gy <= 0 || gy >= gh - 1) continue;
      for (let ox = -r; ox <= r; ox++) {
        const gx = gx0 + ox;
        if (gx <= 0 || gx >= gw - 1) continue;
        const d2 = ox * ox + oy * oy;
        if (d2 > r2) continue;

        const t = 1 - d2 / (r2 + 1e-6);
        const wgt = t * t;
        u[gy * gw + gx] += amp * wgt;
      }
    }
  }

  function waveStep() {
    const c2 = WAVE_C * WAVE_C;

    for (let y = 1; y < gh - 1; y++) {
      const row = y * gw;
      for (let x = 1; x < gw - 1; x++) {
        const i = row + x;

        const lap =
          u[i - 1] + u[i + 1] + u[i - gw] + u[i + gw] - 4 * u[i];

        const sig = sigma[i];
        const dv = (c2 * lap);
        v[i] = (v[i] + dv) * (1 - sig);

        u2[i] = u[i] + v[i];

        u2[i] += WAVE_VISC * lap;
      }
    }

    const tmp = u; u = u2; u2 = tmp;

    for (let x = 0; x < gw; x++) {
      u[x] = 0;
      u[(gh - 1) * gw + x] = 0;
      v[x] = 0;
      v[(gh - 1) * gw + x] = 0;
    }
    for (let y = 0; y < gh; y++) {
      u[y * gw] = 0;
      u[y * gw + (gw - 1)] = 0;
      v[y * gw] = 0;
      v[y * gw + (gw - 1)] = 0;
    }
  }

  function sample(data, x, y) {
    const ix = clamp(x | 0, 0, w - 1);
    const iy = clamp(y | 0, 0, h - 1);
    const idx = (iy * w + ix) * 4;
    return data ? data[idx] / 255 : 0;
  }

  function ink(v, edge = 0.60, gamma = 1.6) {
    const g = Math.pow(v, gamma);
    return g >= edge ? 1 : 0;
  }

  function buildFirstEdgePoints() {
    firstEdgePts = [];
    if (!firstMaskData) return;

    const step = 2;
    const inThr = 0.62;
    const gamma = 1.8;
    const edgeNeed = 1;

    let x0 = w, y0 = h, x1 = 0, y1 = 0;
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 6) {
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 6) {
        if (ink(sample(firstMaskData, x, y), inThr, gamma)) {
          if (x < x0) x0 = x; if (x > x1) x1 = x;
          if (y < y0) y0 = y; if (y > y1) y1 = y;
        }
      }
    }
    if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) return;
    x0 = Math.max(1, x0 - 12); y0 = Math.max(1, y0 - 12);
    x1 = Math.min(w - 2, x1 + 12); y1 = Math.min(h - 2, y1 + 12);

    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y += step) {
      for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x += step) {
        const inside = ink(sample(firstMaskData, x, y), inThr, gamma);
        if (!inside) continue;

        let outside = 0;
        outside += 1 - ink(sample(firstMaskData, x + step, y), inThr, gamma);
        outside += 1 - ink(sample(firstMaskData, x - step, y), inThr, gamma);
        outside += 1 - ink(sample(firstMaskData, x, y + step), inThr, gamma);
        outside += 1 - ink(sample(firstMaskData, x, y - step), inThr, gamma);

        if (outside >= edgeNeed) firstEdgePts.push({ x, y });
      }
    }
  }

  function buildMasks() {
    mctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    const pad = Math.min(w, h) * 0.08;
    const maxWidth = w * 0.6;

    const lines = isMobile
      ? ["Decoding Data.", "Defining Tomorrow."]
      : [TEXT];

    let fontSize = Math.floor(clamp(h * (isMobile ? 0.12 : 0.10), 30, 90));

    mctx.textAlign = "left";
    mctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    mctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      mctx.font = `700 ${fontSize}px ${FONT_FAMILY}`;
      const widest = Math.max(...lines.map(s => mctx.measureText(s).width));
      if (widest <= maxWidth) break;
      fontSize = Math.floor(fontSize * 0.93);
    }

    layout.fontSize = fontSize;

    const cx = w * 0.20;
    const lineGap = fontSize * 1.18;
    const yMid = h * (isMobile ? 0.22 : 0.35);
    const y0 = yMid - (lines.length - 1) * 0.5 * lineGap;

    mctx.font = `700 ${fontSize}px ${FONT_FAMILY}`;
    const widest = Math.max(...lines.map(s => mctx.measureText(s).width));
    const boxPad = fontSize * 0.30;

    const firstLine = lines[0];
    const firstChar = firstLine.trim().slice(0, 1) || "D";

    const line1W = mctx.measureText(firstLine).width;
    const xStart1 = cx;

    layout.xStart = xStart1;
    layout.yMid = yMid;

    const firstWidth = mctx.measureText(firstChar).width;
    layout.firstCenter = { x: xStart1 + firstWidth * 0.55, y: y0 };

    layout._box = {
      x0: Math.max(0, Math.floor(xStart1 - boxPad)),
      x1: Math.min(w, Math.ceil(xStart1 + widest + boxPad)),
      y0: Math.max(0, Math.floor(y0 - fontSize * 0.95 - boxPad)),
      y1: Math.min(h, Math.ceil(y0 + (lines.length - 1) * lineGap + fontSize * 0.95 + boxPad))
    };

    mctx.fillStyle = "black";
    mctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    mctx.save();
    mctx.filter = MASK_BLUR ? `blur(${MASK_BLUR}px)` : "none";
    mctx.fillStyle = "white";
    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      mctx.fillText(lines[i], xStart1, y0 + i * lineGap);
    }
    mctx.restore();
    maskData = mctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;

    mctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    mctx.fillStyle = "black";
    mctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    mctx.save();
    mctx.filter = "none";
    mctx.fillStyle = "white";
    mctx.textAlign = "left";
    mctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    mctx.fillText(firstChar, xStart1, y0);
    mctx.restore();
    firstMaskData = mctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;

    buildFirstEdgePoints();
  }

  function makePoint(rx, ry, isText) {
    const k = isText ? RETURN_TEXT : RETURN_BG;
    return {
      x: rx, y: ry,
      rx, ry,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      k,
      isText,
      inFirst: false,
      heat: isText ? 0.22 : 0.06
    };
  }

  function buildPoints() {
    bg = [];
    textPts = [];
    all = [];

    const rand = (seed => () => (seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647)(1337);

    for (let y = bgSpacing / 2; y < h; y += bgSpacing) {
      for (let x = bgSpacing / 2; x < w; x += bgSpacing) {
        const rx = x + (rand() - 0.5) * 2 * BG_JITTER;
        const ry = y + (rand() - 0.5) * 2 * BG_JITTER;
        const p = makePoint(rx, ry, false);
        bg.push(p);
        all.push(p);
      }
    }

    const b = layout._box || { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: w, y1: h };

    const extra = Math.ceil(layout.fontSize * 0.18);

    const boxX0 = Math.max(0, b.x0 - extra);
    const boxX1 = Math.min(w, b.x1 + extra);
    const boxY0 = Math.max(0, b.y0 - extra);
    const boxY1 = Math.min(h, b.y1 + extra);

    for (let y = boxY0; y < boxY1; y += textStep) {
      for (let x = boxX0; x < boxX1; x += textStep) {
        const rx = x + (rand() - 0.5) * 2 * TEXT_JITTER;
        const ry = y + (rand() - 0.5) * 2 * TEXT_JITTER;

        const m = ink(sample(maskData, rx, ry), 0.62, 1.8);
        if (!m) continue;
        if (m < MASK_THRESHOLD) continue;

        const p = makePoint(rx, ry, true);
        p.inFirst = ink(sample(firstMaskData, rx, ry), 0.62, 1.8) === 1;
        textPts.push(p);
        all.push(p);
      }
    }
  }

  function smoothPow(u, softness) {
    const s = clamp(u, 0, 1);
    const exp = 1 + (1 - softness) * 3;
    return Math.pow(s, exp) * (3 - 2 * s);
  }

  function step(dt, t) {
    const mx = mouse.x, my = mouse.y;
    const mvx = (mx - mouse.px) / Math.max(dt, 1e-4);
    const mvy = (my - mouse.py) / Math.max(dt, 1e-4);
    mouse.px = mx; mouse.py = my;

    const time = t * 0.001;

    if (time >= nextPulseT) {
      const missed = Math.floor((time - nextPulseT) / PULSE_INTERVAL) + 1;
      nextPulseT += missed * PULSE_INTERVAL;
      pulseBurst = BURST_FRAMES;
    }

    if (pulseBurst > 0) {
      if (firstEdgePts.length) {
        const K = Math.min(firstEdgePts.length, 280);
        const per = WAVE_PULSE_INJECT / K;

        for (let k = 0; k < K; k++) {
          const pEdge = firstEdgePts[(Math.random() * firstEdgePts.length) | 0];
          injectWaveDisk(pEdge.x, pEdge.y, per, 22);
        }
      } else {
        injectWave(layout.firstCenter.x, layout.firstCenter.y, WAVE_PULSE_INJECT);
      }
      pulseBurst--;
    }

    if (mouse.active) {
      const speed = Math.hypot(mvx, mvy);

      const s = speed / 650;
      const capped = (3.0 * s) / (1 + s);

      const impulse = WAVE_MOUSE_IMPULSE * capped;
      injectVelDisk(mx, my, impulse, 34);
    }

    waveStep();

    const r = MOUSE_RADIUS;
    const r2 = r * r;

    const HEAT_HALF_LIFE = 0.05;
    const heatDecay = Math.exp(-Math.LN2 * dt / HEAT_HALF_LIFE);

    for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      const p = all[i];

      p.vx += (p.rx - p.x) * p.k;
      p.vy += (p.ry - p.y) * p.k;

      const sW = sampleWaveAndGrad(p.rx, p.ry);

      let gx = clamp(sW.gx, -WAVE_GRAD_CLAMP, WAVE_GRAD_CLAMP);
      let gy = clamp(sW.gy, -WAVE_GRAD_CLAMP, WAVE_GRAD_CLAMP);

      let wScale = p.isText ? WAVE_FORCE_TEXT : WAVE_FORCE_BG;
      if (p.inFirst) wScale = WAVE_FORCE_FIRST;

      p.vx += (-gx) * WAVE_FORCE * wScale * dt;
      p.vy += (-gy) * WAVE_FORCE * wScale * dt;

      if (mouse.active) {
        const dx = p.x - mx;
        const dy = p.y - my;
        const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;

        if (d2 < r2) {
          const d = Math.sqrt(d2) + 1e-6;
          const nx = dx / d, ny = dy / d;

          const u = 1 - (d / r);
          const fall = smoothPow(u, MOUSE_SOFT);

          const moveMag = Math.min(1.6, Math.hypot(mvx, mvy) / 1200);
          const push = MOUSE_PUSH * fall * (0.55 + 0.75 * moveMag);

          const resist = p.isText ? 0.55 : 1.0;
          p.vx += nx * push * resist;
          p.vy += ny * push * resist;

          p.heat = Math.min(1, p.heat + 0.25 * fall);
        }
      }

      p.vx *= DAMPING;
      p.vy *= DAMPING;

      const sp2 = p.vx * p.vx + p.vy * p.vy;
      const ms2 = MAX_SPEED * MAX_SPEED;
      if (sp2 > ms2) {
        const sp = Math.sqrt(sp2);
        p.vx = (p.vx / sp) * MAX_SPEED;
        p.vy = (p.vy / sp) * MAX_SPEED;
      }

      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;

      p.heat *= heatDecay;

      const au = Math.abs(sW.u);
      const u0 = .8;
      if (au > u0) {
        p.heat = Math.min(1, p.heat + (au - u0) * WAVE_HEAT);
      }

      const disp = Math.hypot(p.x - p.rx, p.y - p.ry);
      const denom = p.isText ? (layout.fontSize * 0.35) : BG_SPACING;
      const norm = disp / Math.max(1e-6, denom);
      p.heat = Math.min(1, p.heat + Math.min(0.06, norm * 0.035));

      if (au < 0.4) p.heat *= 0.92;
    }

    draw();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(245,243,237,${BG_ALPHA})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < bg.length; i++) {
      const p = bg[i];
      ctx.moveTo(p.x + DOT_R, p.y);
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, DOT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    }
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(245,243,237,${TEXT_ALPHA})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < textPts.length; i++) {
      const p = textPts[i];
      ctx.moveTo(p.x + DOT_R, p.y);
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, DOT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    }
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,252,245,${LIT_ALPHA})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      const p = all[i];
      if (p.heat < 0.55) continue;
      ctx.moveTo(p.x + DOT_R, p.y);
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, DOT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    }
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function resize() {
    const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    w = Math.max(1, Math.floor(r.width));
    h = Math.max(1, Math.floor(r.height));

    isMobile = Math.min(w, h) < 520;
    bgSpacing = isMobile ? 13 : BG_SPACING;
    textStep  = isMobile ? 1 : TEXT_SAMPLE_STEP;
    dpr = Math.min(DPR_CAP, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);

    canvas.width = Math.floor(w * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(h * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    maskCanvas.width = w;
    maskCanvas.height = h;

    buildMasks();
    buildPoints();
    waveResize();

    const heroEl = document.querySelector(".hero.home-hero");
    const subheadEl = document.querySelector(".hero-subhead-standalone");
    if (heroEl && subheadEl && layout._box) {
      const heroTop = heroEl.getBoundingClientRect().top;
      const rootFont = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize) || 16;
      const heroPadTop = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(heroEl).paddingTop) || 0;
      const gapRem = 1;
      const subheadOffsetPx = Math.max(0, layout._box.y1 - heroTop - heroPadTop + gapRem * rootFont);
      const subheadOffsetRem = subheadOffsetPx / rootFont;
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--hero-subhead-offset", `${subheadOffsetRem}rem`);

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const subheadH = subheadEl.offsetHeight || 0;
        const boxGapRem = -20;
        const boxOffsetPx = Math.max(0, subheadOffsetPx + subheadH + boxGapRem * rootFont);
        const boxOffsetRem = boxOffsetPx / rootFont;
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--hero-box-offset", `${boxOffsetRem}rem`);
      });
    }

    if (reduceMotion) {
      for (const p of all) p.heat = p.isText ? 0.35 : 0.05;
      draw();
      return;
    }

    draw();
  }

  function loop(t) {
    if (!running || reduceMotion) return;

    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (t - lastT) / 1000);
    lastT = t;

    if (FPS_LIMIT > 0) {
      const frame = 1 / FPS_LIMIT;
      acc += dt;
      if (acc < frame) { requestAnimationFrame(loop); return; }
      step(frame, t);
      acc -= frame;
    } else {
      step(dt, t);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }

  resize();
  if (!reduceMotion) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
